# Local ViennaRNA engine

This site's free research tool redistributes a build of ViennaRNA **2.7.2** by
the ViennaRNA authors and the Institute for Theoretical Chemistry, University of
Vienna. The engine was compiled from the official source archive, with no changes
to its algorithms or thermodynamic parameter tables. The only project-specific
C source is [`tools/rna_wasm/fold.c`](../../../tools/rna_wasm/fold.c).

## Source and compiler

- Source: <https://www.tbi.univie.ac.at/RNA/download/sourcecode/2_7_x/ViennaRNA-2.7.2.tar.gz>
- Source SHA-256: `1ab5f4a4f76fc85a2243546088e45f5d85f2d7a56cc656e969b005cce9bfab5f`
- Upstream release: <https://github.com/ViennaRNA/ViennaRNA/releases/tag/v2.7.2>
- Emscripten **4.0.15**, SDK revision `389a68bc35dcff7ebae4614e1615099dafda00d1`,
  toolchain revision `b412b6307e541b93dd93f01b61181e15c17302ec`.
- SDK: <https://github.com/emscripten-core/emsdk/tree/4.0.15>
- Build recipe: `tools/rna_wasm/build.sh` at the repository root. It verifies the
  source archive hash and compiler version. Builds retain their source and logs
  in a temporary directory for inspection. The distributed WASM is reproducible
  from these public sources and the checked-in wrapper; it is not an opaque
  third-party binary.

## Shipped assets (SHA-256)

| Asset | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `vienna.js` | `4ae452a284549f6b5d1fee6c8d54ac09918868d7736110c64b4141c57b95a09b` |
| `vienna.wasm` | `5ebadc41700fc83237c1b1213ecb925c4ef852558e810ede0b174aabca7a3786` |

The worker verifies the WASM hash before instantiation. All assets are served
from the site; no CDN or folding server receives sequences. No shared memory,
cross-origin isolation, or special server headers are required. Cache availability
offline depends on the browser's HTTP cache; first use offline reports an error.

Optional ViennaRNA applications, SIMD, OpenMP, pthreads, MPFR, GSL, libsvm,
RNAforester, RNAxplorer, scripting bindings, and the separately licensed Naview
layout are disabled. The linked executable exports only `fold_mfe`; Emscripten
dead-strips unreachable library code. It has no filesystem or network imports.

## Numerical model

Linear, unconstrained RNA MFE; Turner 2004 RNA parameters; 37 °C; dangles 2;
salt 1.021 M; GU pairs and lonely pairs permitted; minimum hairpin loop 3;
no G-quadruplexes. Other model fields retain ViennaRNA 2.7.2 defaults, matching
Python `RNA.fold`. This is a short-window MFE calculation, not an ensemble or
pseudoknot prediction. Input is restricted to 1–100 A/C/G/U bases.

References generated by `tools/rna_wasm/make_references.py` use Python ViennaRNA
2.7.2 and independently mutate a complete synthetic genome before extracting
windows. Browser/Node comparisons require absolute error **≤ 1e-5 kcal/mol**.
